object.attr: as implemented: the program runs with a 300 s timeout (STATUS.md). Its message wrongly suggests a network problem (SCALING.md), a defect to fix. MELLON-PDF-SRS-71 would replace it with one limit for the whole export.
object.description: Where Mellon produces PDFs with a separate program, if the program hasn't finished 300 s after the program's start, Mellon shall stop the program and end the export.
